Direct OSM API HTTP 200: name=Vila de Jericoacoara; place=suburb; denotes Vila de Jericoacoara settlement, not national park, beach, or whole municipality. The IBGE:GEOCODIGO tag is municipal district code, not used as separate village identity.

WGS84 named-settlement representative point copied from OSM named settlement node. Not asserted as geometric centroid, administrative boundary, hotel entrance or individual attraction. No averaged coordinates.

Official municipality page explicitly distinguishes Vila de Jericoacoara, beach and national park; published MD describes village as base for surrounding trips. OSM node is the settlement, no national-park/beach/municipality QID assigned.

Independent publisher's named-settlement point (-2.7933,-40.5127), Brazil/Ceará, lies approximately 349 m from OSM village node. Corroborates locality only, not survey accuracy; no weather/climate assertions are collected.
Direct IBGE API HTTP 200 returns Jijoca de Jericoacoara district/municipality Ceará. OSM IBGE code does not distinguish Vila de Jericoacoara, so not stored as a village identifier.
